name: RPS Flag Hunt
description: Print the board once and the 14-piece team plate twice in distinct colors. Use PLA at 100% scale with a 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layers, and supports off. Print the board with its seats up and the cylinders upright on their circular bases. Use the 2 × 2 test board to check the fit first. The full board is 148 × 128 mm with seven columns and six rows at 20 mm pitch. Rim notches mark the two setup rows on each end. Stand each piece in a seat with its engraved side facing its owner.
